about: The game's sound slots: everything the game plays, by name. Read by SoundKit (client3d/sound_kit.gd), which Sfx plays them through; tools/sound_status.gd writes docs/sound_status.md and THIRD_PARTY.md's sound block from it. A slot is played from, in order: its own takes in art/audio/<category>/<slot>/ (<slot>.ogg, <slot>.2.ogg ...; .wav too), named in 'source'; its fill, files of a third-party source (its 'path' + each of 'files'); its fallback, another slot; else a placeholder blip (a bed: silence). 'noise' is the sim noise the sound goes with (a key of SoundKit.NOISES: World.noise's kind, or one radius of it such as thud_light; Senses' radius is how far both monsters and players hear it); null means monsters do not hear it, and 'range' (cells) is how far players do. 'positional': false plays it flat (UI, beds). 'type' is oneshot, loop or bed; 'bus' is sfx, ambience, voice, ui or music. A source stored 'external' keeps its files outside the repo (its licence forbids sharing them); art/audio/takes.json lists each take of one.

source.notes: Jeff's "umbrage-theme" (his master, the second version: 48 kHz 24-bit stereo WAV, 85.33 s, 32 bars at 90 bpm, peak -3.6 dBFS, rms -25.6; kept in his music folder, not the repo); Ogg Vorbis q7 at its own level, the same 4096000 frames; Jeff, 2026-10-25, by way of the coordinator: "umbrage-theme wav has been done", then his update the same day

amb.torch_fire.uses: the crackle of a torch or brazier, from where it burns; Ambience, from the nearest torch heard

amb.campfire.uses: a camp's fire, fuller than a torch: a rest camp's or a raid camp's (777, sound's side); Ambience, from the nearest camp fire heard (Client3D.campfire_cells)

amb.camp_bandit.uses: a held bandit camp's murmur by its fire: rough men's voices, a laugh now and then (795 amended (2); Ambience, while a bandit lives within 4 of a "bandit" or "mixed" camp's fire)

amb.camp_trader.uses: a held trader camp's murmur by its fire: quiet talk (795 amended (2); Ambience, at a "trader" or "mixed" camp's fire while it is held)

amb.mine_tunnel.uses: a mine's tunnel: near-silent air, no steady tone (769 amended (4)); a bed under a zone, time or weather; Ambience.weights, by Ambience.openness

amb.mine_chamber.uses: a mine's chamber: wider air, a far trickle (769 amended (4)); a bed under a zone, time or weather; Ambience.weights, by Ambience.openness

amb.mine_drip.uses: a drop falling somewhere in a mine, now and then (769 amended (4)); Ambience._drip, a floor cell DRIP_NEAR..DRIP_FAR off

amb.timber_creak.uses: a mine's timbers creaking now and then near an arch or beam (769 amended (4)); Ambience._creak, from the nearest within TIMBER_NEAR

amb.lamp_hiss.uses: a mine's wall lamp, its soft flame (769 amended (4)); Ambience, from the nearest mine_lamp heard

amb.lair_cave.uses: a beast's cave (level.json "ambience": "cave_lair", 795 amended): low, close air, heavier than a mine's, no steady tone; a bed in place of the crypt's, Ambience.weights

amb.skylight_air.uses: the outside's faint air through a gap in a cave's roof (797's skylights; 795 amended): wind in leaves, from the nearest skylight heard

sfx.pick_strike.uses: a pick (or any blow) striking an ore seam (769 amended (4)); Client3D._on_struck, a Seam struck

sfx.ore_sack.uses: ore tumbling into a sack as a seam gives one (769 amended (4)); Client3D._sync_seam, its hp back up or spent

sfx.minecart_roll.uses: a mine cart rolling on its track (769 amended (4)); Client3D._sync_cart, held while it moves

sfx.minecart_stop.uses: a mine cart coming to a stop (769 amended (4)); Client3D._sync_cart, CART_STOP_MS after its last move

amb.owl.uses: an owl calling now and then in the trees at night, more under a forest's roof; Ambience.calls, up in the trees round the listener

amb.bat.uses: bats flitting at night by a forest's edges and clearings and by towers; Ambience.calls, overhead near the listener

amb.stream.uses: running water: a stream heard from the nearest point of its course, before it is seen; Ambience, one per stream at the point of its course nearest the listener

amb.falls.uses: water tumbling down a stream's fall, from the fall, louder with its drop; Ambience, one at each fall (Client3D.stream_falls) within reach

amb.draft.uses: a cool draft breathing through the barrow's hidden door, from its edge, until the door opens (608 amended); Ambience, from the edge of terrain "niches"' hidden entry while its Door is shut
